|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">ジェダイの騎士。ヨーダの教えを受けた。ベイル・オーガナの友人。ケノービ将軍はクローン大戦時に旧共和国軍の英雄となった。アナキンとルーク・スカイウォーカーの導師。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Obi-Wan Kenobi.

'''Card text:''' If he has participated since the start of a battle, use 1 Force to select an opposing character with ability 1 and force it to move at no movement cost. If it does not move, place it in the Lost Pile immediately. Immune to attrition less than 5.

'''Lore:''' A Jedi Knight taught by Yoda and a friend of Bail Organa. General Kenobi became a hero of the Old Republic's military during the Clone Wars. Mentor to Anakin and [[Luke Skywalker|Luke Skywalker]].
